briefdescription.para: Trace predecessor, or NULL for the first block in the trace.
Trace successor, or NULL for the last block in the trace.
The block number of the head of the trace. (When hasValidDepth()).
The block number of the tail of the trace. (When hasValidHeight()).
Accumulated number of instructions in the trace above this block.

detaileddescription.para: Does not include instructions in this block.

briefdescription.para: Accumulated number of instructions in the trace below this block.
Instruction depths have been computed. This implies hasValidDepth().
Instruction heights have been computed. This implies hasValidHeight().

detaileddescription.para: This is the number of cycles in the longest data dependency chain through the trace. This is only valid when both HasValidInstrDepths and HasValidInstrHeights are set.
These registers are defined above the current block and used by this block or a block below it. This does not include PHI uses in the current block, but it does include PHI uses in deeper blocks.

briefdescription.para: Returns true if the depth resources have been computed from the trace above this block.
Returns true if the height resources have been computed from the trace below this block.
Invalidate depth resources when some block above this one has changed.
Invalidate height resources when a block below this one has changed.
Assuming that this is a dominator of TBI, determine if it contains useful instruction depths.

detaileddescription.para: A dominating block can be above the current trace head, and any dependencies from such a far away dominator are not expected to affect the critical path.
Also returns true when TBI == this.

briefdescription.para: Per-basic block information that relates to a specific trace through the block.

detaileddescription.para: Convergent traces means that only one of these is required per block in a trace ensemble.
